research.title: Probability Calibration Under Label Shift
bullets: Designed controlled label shift experiments comparing temperature scaling and prior correction while holding class conditional feature distributions fixed.
Analyzed calibration error, log loss, and reliability diagrams across resampled test distributions, examining sensitivity to estimated class priors.

research.title: Missing Data Effects on Predictive Uncertainty
bullets: Designed experiments comparing multiple imputation and missingness indicators under random and feature dependent masking of tabular predictors.
Analyzed predictive error and interval coverage across missingness conditions, separating variability attributable to imputation from downstream model fitting.

research.title: Conformal Prediction Under Heteroskedastic Noise
bullets: Designed simulation and tabular regression experiments comparing split conformal and conformalized quantile prediction under varying conditional noise patterns.
Analyzed marginal coverage, subgroup coverage, and interval width to characterize how calibration sample composition affected uncertainty estimates.

publications.title: Calibration Sample Composition and Subgroup Coverage in Conformal Regression Under Heteroskedastic Noise

work.title: Data Validation and Batch Processing Services
bullets: Implemented validation checks and retry handling for batch data ingestion, enforcing schema consistency before records entered downstream processing.
Maintained integration tests and investigated processing failures using application logs, documenting error conditions and coordinating fixes with dependent service maintainers.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression workflows with standardized predictors and nested cross validation for selecting regularization parameters.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability across correlated feature settings, examining how resampling affected variable selection.

projects.title: Kernel Approximation for Nonlinear Classification
bullets: Implemented random Fourier feature and Nyström approximations for kernel classification, using shared preprocessing and matched training splits.
Compared approximation settings through held out classification performance, training time, and memory requirements while varying feature representation size.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Estimation with Incomplete Observations
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixtures with missing features and a baseline using mean imputation before mixture fitting.
Compared clustering agreement and observed data likelihood across masking patterns, checking convergence behavior and sensitivity to initialization.
